sources.title: Mathlon — Learn Math with an AI Tutor
sources.snippet: An audio-visual math tutor. You talk through a problem out loud, and Mathlon explains it back while drawing every step on a shared whiteboard — equations, graphs, diagrams, the lot. It's built to teach the way a good human tutor does, not to spit out a final answer and leave you to reverse-engineer it.
